fields.label: HTML Block
fields.content:
How to Complete This Form

This form tracks morning and evening transportation trips provided each day of the month. The form automatically calculates daily totals (maximum 2 per day) and the monthly total.

Step 1: Enter Basic Information
  1. Client Name: Enter the full name of the client receiving transportation services.
  2. Month / Year: Select any day in the month you're reporting. This sets the month and year for all trip entries.
Step 2: Record Daily Transportation Trips

For each day of the month, check the boxes that apply:

  • AM Trip Provided: Check this box if you provided a morning transportation trip on that date.
  • PM Trip Provided: Check this box if you provided an evening transportation trip on that date.
  • Total Trips Provided (0-2): This column automatically calculates based on your AM and PM selections. The maximum is 2 trips per day.

Helpful Tip: The table covers dates 1-31 to accommodate all months. For months with fewer days, simply leave the extra dates unchecked.

Clear All Button: If you need to start over, use the "Clear All" button to uncheck all boxes at once.

Note: Your selections are saved automatically on this device as you work.

Step 3: Review Auto-Calculated Totals

The form automatically calculates totals in two places:

Daily Totals

The Total Trips Provided column shows the sum of AM and PM trips for each day (displayed as 0, 1, or 2).

Trips by Day Section

This section automatically creates a 31-row summary of all trips. You can add or remove rows using the + and - buttons if needed, though 31 rows are provided by default.

Monthly Total Trips

At the bottom of the form, the Monthly Total Trips field displays the auto-calculated sum of all trips provided during the month. This value is automatically computed and should be between 0 and 62 trips.

Important: The total should usually equal AM + PM for each day combined across the month.

Step 4: Review and Submit
  1. Review the daily entries to ensure all transportation trips are accurately recorded.
  2. Verify that the monthly total makes sense based on the number of days you provided service.
  3. Confirm that the client name and month/year are correct.
  4. Click Submit to finalize the form.

Note: This form stores your entries automatically on your device, so you can return to complete it later if needed.

fields.label: Enhancement Script
fields.content:
<script>
(function(){
  var FORM_ID = '22';
  var LIST_FIELD_ID = '25';
  var TOTAL_FIELD_ID = '30';
  var MAX_DAYS = 31;

  function qs(sel, root){ return (root||document).querySelector(sel); }
  function qsa(sel, root){ return Array.from((root||document).querySelectorAll(sel)); }

  function ensureRows(fieldEl, target){
    var table = fieldEl.querySelector('table.gfield_list');
    var addBtn = fieldEl.querySelector('.add_list_item, .gform-icon--plus, .gfield_list_icons .add');
    if(!table || !addBtn) return;
    var current = table.querySelectorAll('tbody tr').length;
    for (var i=current; i<target; i++) addBtn.click();
  }

  function hideNativeAndWrap(fieldEl){
    qsa('tbody tr', fieldEl).forEach(function(tr, idx){
      var tds = qsa('td', tr);
      var dayInput  = tds[0] && tds[0].querySelector('input[type="text"]');
      var amInput   = tds[1] && tds[1].querySelector('input[type="text"]');
      var pmInput   = tds[2] && tds[2].querySelector('input[type="text"]');
      var totInput  = tds[3] && tds[3].querySelector('input[type="text"]');
      if(!dayInput || !amInput || !pmInput || !totInput) return;

      if(!dayInput.value) dayInput.value = String(idx+1);

      dayInput.style.display = 'none';
      amInput.style.display  = 'none';
      pmInput.style.display  = 'none';
      totInput.style.display = 'none';

      var dayLabel = document.createElement('div');
      dayLabel.textContent = dayInput.value;
      dayLabel.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Day '+dayInput.value);
      tds[0].appendChild(dayLabel);

      var amCb = document.createElement('input');
      amCb.type = 'checkbox';
      amCb.setAttribute('aria-label','AM trip provided on day '+dayInput.value);
      amCb.checked = /^y/i.test((amInput.value||'').trim());
      tds[1].appendChild(amCb);

      var pmCb = document.createElement('input');
      pmCb.type = 'checkbox';
      pmCb.setAttribute('aria-label','PM trip provided on day '+dayInput.value);
      pmCb.checked = /^y/i.test((pmInput.value||'').trim());
      tds[2].appendChild(pmCb);

      var sel = document.createElement('select');
      ['0','1','2'].forEach(function(v){
        var o = document.createElement('option'); o.value=v; o.textContent=v; sel.appendChild(o);
      });
      var init = totInput.value ? parseInt(totInput.value,10) : ((amCb.checked?1:0) + (pmCb.checked?1:0));
      sel.value = String(Math.max(0, Math.min(2, isNaN(init)?0:init)));
      tds[3].appendChild(sel);

      function updateGrandTotal(){
        var fieldEl2 = qs('#field_'+FORM_ID+'_'+LIST_FIELD_ID);
        if(!fieldEl2) return;
        var sum = 0;
        qsa('tbody tr', fieldEl2).forEach(function(tr2){
          var tds2 = qsa('td', tr2);
          var totInput2 = tds2[3] && tds2[3].querySelector('input[type="text"]');
          if(totInput2){
            var v = parseInt(totInput2.value||'0',10);
            if(!isNaN(v)) sum += v;
          }
        });
        var totalInput = qs('#input_'+FORM_ID+'_'+TOTAL_FIELD_ID);
        if(totalInput){ totalInput.value = String(sum); }
      }

      function syncFromChecks(){
        var val = (amCb.checked?1:0) + (pmCb.checked?1:0);
        sel.value = String(val);
        amInput.value = amCb.checked ? 'Y' : '';
        pmInput.value = pmCb.checked ? 'Y' : '';
        totInput.value = String(val);
        updateGrandTotal();
      }

      function syncFromSelect(){
        var enforced = (amCb.checked?1:0) + (pmCb.checked?1:0);
        if (String(enforced) !== sel.value) sel.value = String(enforced);
        totInput.value = sel.value;
        updateGrandTotal();
      }

      amCb.addEventListener('change', syncFromChecks);
      pmCb.addEventListener('change', syncFromChecks);
      sel.addEventListener('change', syncFromSelect);

      syncFromChecks();
    });
  }

  function init(){
    var fieldEl = qs('#field_'+FORM_ID+'_'+LIST_FIELD_ID);
    if(!fieldEl) return;
    var tbl = fieldEl.querySelector('table.gfield_list');
    if(tbl){ tbl.style.tableLayout='auto'; }
    ensureRows(fieldEl, MAX_DAYS);
    hideNativeAndWrap(fieldEl);
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading'){
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  } else { init(); }
})();
</script>
